logicRules.churn: Deal is currently in Churned stage and hs_v2_date_entered_1435517126 is in the current year.

logicRules.delayed: Active renewal account only: contract_renewal_date passed and no same-company Booked/Cashed deal entered its current stage this year. Churned accounts are excluded from follow-up.

logic.source: Google Sheets only: 2026 Budget + Retention Accounts Booking + Retention Accounts Collection.
logic.upcoming: Upcoming comes from Budget 2026 only: renewal month is current month or future month and no booking/collection action exists.
logic.delayed: Delayed means Budget renewal month already passed and no booking/collection action exists.
logic.bookedValue: Booked Value shown in the dashboard is only booking still pending collection. If booking is fully collected, it is not counted as booked anymore.
logic.bookingSheetValue: Raw value from Retention Accounts Booking sheet before subtracting collected cash.
logic.cashCollected: Cash Collected comes from Retention Accounts Collection sheet.
logic.remainingCollection: Remaining Collection = Booking sheet value - Collected value, never below zero.
logic.cashed: If collected value exists and remaining is zero, the account is Cashed.
logic.partiallyCashed: If collected value exists but remaining is still above zero, the account is Partially Cashed.
logic.bookedPendingCollection: If booking exists and collection does not exist, the account is Booked - Pending Collection.
logic.renewedLate: If first booking/collection month is after Budget renewal month.
logic.renewedOnTime: If first booking/collection month is same as or before Budget renewal month.
logic.matching: Match by GID + normalized client name first, then name, then GID only if the Budget GID is not duplicated.
logic.duplicateGidProtection: If the same GID appears on multiple Budget clients, GID-only matching is disabled to avoid assigning booking/collection to the wrong account.
logic.skippedRows: Rows with zero renewal/action or suspicious large blank-status values are skipped and listed in debug.skippedBudgetRows.
logic.sheetOnlyNotInBudget: Booking/Collection rows that do not exist in Budget 2026 are still included in booked/cash totals. They are not treated as No Action Yet; renewal value remains zero and the row carries budgetNote = Not in Budget 2026.
